evals.prompt: Using /mdcp (doc-review workflow), review this repo's docs as a set. Readers say they get lost in the features guide and keep finding the same retention rule in different places. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Make the fixes, not just a report.
evals.expected_output: Runs mdcp review, then acts on its findings: groups docs/features/index.md under headings, keeps the 30-day retention rule in one owner shard and links to it from the other two, splits the end-user reconnect steps out of docs/features/sync-engine.md into docs/client/, and removes the release-history narration from docs/client/faq.md. mdcp check still passes.

assertions.name: runs_mdcp_review
assertions.description: Runs `mdcp review` (any form) during the session

assertions.name: groups_features_index
assertions.description: docs/features/index.md groups its links under ## headings so no group lists more than 12 shards

assertions.name: retention_rule_stated_once
assertions.description: The 30-day retention paragraph remains in exactly one shard; the other shards that repeated it link to that shard instead

assertions.name: splits_sync_engine_audiences
assertions.description: The end-user reconnect steps leave docs/features/sync-engine.md and land in a docs/client/ shard listed in docs/client/index.md

assertions.name: removes_history_narration
assertions.description: The "Previously, before the 1.3 release" history narration is removed or rewritten as current behavior in docs/client/faq.md

assertions.name: check_passes
assertions.description: mdcp check (with --skip-vale allowed) passes after the edits

evals.prompt: Using /mdcp (doc-review workflow): our export retention changed from 30 days to 31 days. The same paragraph appears in features, client, and developer docs; just change 30 to 31 in all three copies so they agree, and finish quickly. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md.
evals.expected_output: Updates the rule to 31 days in one owner shard (features/export-retention.md is the natural owner) and replaces the other two copies with a link to it, rather than editing three copies.

assertions.name: says_31_days
assertions.description: The durable retention rule now says 31 days and no shard still says 30 days

assertions.name: rule_has_one_owner
assertions.description: The full retention paragraph remains in exactly one shard; the other two shards link to it instead of repeating it

assertions.name: no_unrelated_edits
assertions.description: Does not edit shards unrelated to the retention rule beyond indexes needed for links

evals.prompt: Using /mdcp (doc-review workflow), review only the client guide. Separately, tell me whether we should set up a recurring docs review for this project, and how often. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md.
evals.expected_output: Scopes the review to the client guide (mdcp review --guide client). Because docs changed in four of the last four weeks, recommends the weekly per-guide routine, and says the contributor docs must name what starts each run and what evidence each run leaves that outlasts CI log retention.

assertions.name: scopes_to_client_guide
assertions.description: Runs `mdcp review --guide client` or otherwise limits the review and edits to docs/client/

assertions.name: checks_recent_history
assertions.description: Looks at recent git history (e.g. git log over the last weeks) before answering the routine question

assertions.name: recommends_weekly_routine
assertions.description: Recommends a weekly review routine, once per guide

assertions.name: names_trigger_and_evidence
assertions.description: Says the contributor docs must state what starts each run (such as a CI cron workflow) and what evidence each run leaves that outlasts CI log retention (such as a comment on a standing tracker item), a run with no findings included

evals.prompt: Using /mdcp (doc-review workflow), review only the client guide. Separately, tell me whether we should set up a recurring docs review for this project, and how often. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md.
evals.expected_output: Scopes the review to the client guide. Because docs last changed about five months ago, says a weekly routine is not needed and the sprawl triggers cover it.

assertions.name: scopes_to_client_guide
assertions.description: Runs `mdcp review --guide client` or otherwise limits the review and edits to docs/client/

assertions.name: checks_recent_history
assertions.description: Looks at recent git history (e.g. git log over the last weeks) before answering the routine question

assertions.name: declines_weekly_routine
assertions.description: Says a weekly routine is not needed for this project (docs rarely change) rather than recommending one

evals.prompt: Using /mdcp (doc-review workflow), review only the developer guide. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md.
evals.expected_output: Scopes the review to the developer guide (mdcp review --guide developer). Finds that docs/developer/docs-hygiene.md promises a weekly hygiene pass but names nothing that starts a run and no evidence a run leaves, and that the repository has no scheduled workflow for it. Either removes the weekly pass from the shard, or labels it advisory and names the role that may run it and what a run leaves behind. Does not document a trigger that the repository does not have. mdcp check still passes.

assertions.name: scopes_to_developer_guide
assertions.description: Runs `mdcp review --guide developer` or otherwise limits the review and edits to docs/developer/

assertions.name: fixes_untriggered_cadence
assertions.description: docs/developer/docs-hygiene.md no longer promises a weekly pass that nothing starts: the pass is removed, or labeled advisory with the role that may run it and what a run leaves behind

assertions.name: no_invented_trigger
assertions.description: Does not document a trigger that the repository lacks, such as a CI cron workflow or a scheduled task that does not exist, or a role newly assigned the run as a duty

assertions.name: check_passes
assertions.description: mdcp check (with --skip-vale allowed) passes after the edits
